title: PHP armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
slides: Can one PHP bug break the entire internet?
OpenAI and Wiz found holes in PHP itself
The flaws date back years, unnoticed by everyone
Any server running unpatched PHP is exposed now
Check your PHP version before you sleep tonight
thread_text:
1. The bug that slept for years

Security researchers at OpenAI and Wiz found critical flaws in PHP itself — not in a plugin, not in a theme. The code running most of the web.

2. Years of silence, broken

These vulnerabilities remained undetected for years while countless servers ran them. The discovery window was wide open the entire time.

3. Every unpatched server is live bait

If your PHP installation hasn't been updated, you are exposed right now. No exploit kit needed — the door is already open.

4. Attackers don't wait for you

Public disclosure means scanners are already sweeping for vulnerable versions. The clock started the moment the research went live.

5. Check your version tonight

Open your terminal and run php -v. If it's not the latest patch, update it before you sleep. Then ask: when did you last check?
